description: This file defines actions and capabilities for Matrix messaging within a plugin, including action creation, schema building, and action handling logic.

classes.name: ChannelMessageActionAdapter
classes.description: Interface for message action adapters, providing methods for describing message tools, checking supported actions, extracting tool send data, and handling actions.

methods.name: createMatrixExposedActions
methods.description: Creates a set of Matrix actions exposed based on gate permissions and encryption status.

methods.name: buildMatrixProfileToolSchema
methods.description: Builds the schema for the Matrix profile update tool, including display name and avatar URL.
